rationale: The assistant correctly identified that TVs are outside the service, pointed to manufacturer support or an electronics repairer, and warned not to open the case because of the dangerous charge in the power supply. It offered no simple non-invasive checks such as input source, power reset or torch test, and did not ask about sound or smell, so it was less useful than it could have been. The reply also begins with a fragment, with the product name missing, but that is minor.
